QUOTE: Without `MBEDTLS_CT_ASM`, `constant_time.c:23-29` defines `volatile mbedtls_ct_uint_t mbedtls_ct_zero = 0`, and the barrier becomes `x ^ mbedtls_ct_zero`.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says that without assembly the same barrier function (`mbedtls_ct_compiler_opaque`) XORs with the volatile zero global `mbedtls_ct_zero`.
